name: Film and TV
description: Movies, shows and the people in them.
theme: film and television from the twentieth century to the present: the films and shows themselves, the people in front of and behind the camera, and the stories of how they were made
angles: the actor behind a character, or the character behind an actor
the director of a film everyone has seen
a famous line quoted plainly, name the film
the book or true story a film was adapted from
the decade a landmark film or show arrived
sequels and spin-offs, and the order the story actually runs in
a role famously turned down, recast or nearly cast elsewhere
animated films and the studio behind them
the city or era a well known show is set in
a catchphrase, and the show it belongs to
a premise described without naming it, name the show
how long a long-running show actually ran
franchises, how many entries, and what the first was called
actors who played the same character across different films
the composer behind a score people recognise in three notes
avoid: anything released in the last two years, current viewing figures and box office totals, celebrity personal lives, plot spoilers, and questions where a remake and its original would both fit
